title: 3rd Stopping Place 3rd Truth The Comparison Of The Army Of 400 000 Nations

questions.question: In spring, how many examples of coming back to life are made in a few weeks?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: What season is used as a small example of gathering after rising again?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: For one tree, how many kinds of rising again are mentioned?
questions.answer: Four.

questions.question: What four parts of a tree are named in these four risings again?
questions.answer: The tree itself, its leaves, its flowers, and its fruits.

questions.question: What does spring show our eyes about the new season and the one before it?
questions.answer: It shows that spring comes again in the same way as the earlier spring.

questions.question: What is given to each kind in the great army of living things?
questions.answer: Food, protection, special covering, commands, release, and needed tools.

questions.question: About how many different kinds are in that army?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: How are these things given to them?
questions.answer: In a very orderly and careful way.

questions.question: Are mistakes and mix-ups part of this giving?
questions.answer: No. It happens without mistakes, confusion, or leaving things out.

questions.question: When are these gifts and needs given?
questions.answer: At the right time.

questions.question: Is this giving expected in an ordinary way or surprising?
questions.answer: It is surprising.

questions.question: What truths does this order show about Allah?
questions.answer: His oneness, uniqueness, great power, and wide mercy.

questions.question: Where is the message of Allah’s oneness written?
questions.answer: On the earth and in every spring.

questions.question: What is used like a pen to write that message?
questions.answer: Divine determining.

questions.question: What happens in spring during just a few weeks?
questions.answer: Many living things are brought out again in a very orderly way.

questions.question: How many examples of this are mentioned?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: What big idea does spring remind us of?
questions.answer: Rising again after death and gathering.

questions.question: What example from a tree helps explain this idea?
questions.answer: A tree has four kinds of renewal.

questions.question: Which parts of the tree show this renewal?
questions.answer: The trunk or tree itself, the leaves, the flowers, and the fruits.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the new spring compared with the earlier one?
questions.answer: It appears like the earlier spring.

questions.question: What does each group in the great living army receive?
questions.answer: Its own food, defense, clothing, directions, ending of duties, and tools.

questions.question: Why does giving different things to so many groups seem amazing?
questions.answer: Because there are four hundred thousand kinds, and each gets what it needs.

questions.question: What do the words about no error and no missing things teach us?
questions.answer: Everything is managed perfectly.

questions.question: What does giving all needs on time teach us?
questions.answer: The care is wise and well planned.

questions.question: What qualities of Allah are shown by this perfect spring order?
questions.answer: Unity, oneness, uniqueness, endless power, and great mercy.

questions.question: What does “on the face of the earth” mean here?
questions.answer: All across the earth.

questions.question: What is written on every spring page?
questions.answer: A message showing Allah is One.

questions.question: Which season in the passage is full of signs to look at?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What happens in spring that is compared to being raised again?
questions.answer: Huge numbers of living things appear again.

questions.question: How many such examples are named?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: Is this done slowly over many years or quickly in a short time?
questions.answer: Quickly in a short time.

questions.question: What words best describe how this is done?
questions.answer: With order and discipline.

questions.question: In the tree example, how many renewals are listed?
questions.answer: Four.

questions.question: Name one part of the tree included in that list.
questions.answer: Its leaves.

questions.question: What does each species in the living army get besides food?
questions.answer: Weapons for defense, special clothing, commands, release, and tools.

questions.question: Does every species get the exact same things or what fits it?
questions.answer: What fits it.

questions.question: What can we understand from each kind getting the right things at the right time?
questions.answer: There is careful planning and perfect control.

questions.question: What shows that this care does not fail?
questions.answer: There is no mistake, confusion, or forgetting.

questions.question: Which two qualities are joined with great power in this passage?
questions.answer: Oneness and mercy.

questions.question: What is like a written sign of Allah’s unity each year?
questions.answer: Every spring on the earth.

questions.question: What number of examples of rising again is seen in spring?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: What does that make spring a sample of?
questions.answer: The gathering after resurrection.

questions.question: How long does it take for these examples to appear?
questions.answer: A few weeks.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way they appear?
questions.answer: They appear with great order and discipline.

questions.question: How many forms of renewal are named for a tree?
questions.answer: Four.

questions.question: What are they?
questions.answer: The tree, the leaves, the flowers, and the fruits.

questions.question: What does the passage say spring is like when we see it again?
questions.answer: It is like the spring before.

questions.question: How many different species are in the army of glory?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: What are two things every species is given?
questions.answer: Suitable food and needed tools.

questions.question: What are two more things every species is given?
questions.answer: Means of defense and special clothing.

questions.question: What else is given about their duties?
questions.answer: Their commands and their release from duty.

questions.question: What details show this work is perfect?
questions.answer: It is done neatly, on time, with no mistakes, no confusion, and nothing left out.

questions.question: What big truths does this perfect work prove?
questions.answer: Allah is One, unique, all-powerful, and very merciful.

questions.question: What is written across the earth in spring?
questions.answer: A clear sign of Allah’s unity.

questions.question: In the passage, what season is described as a sign of life returning?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: What large number is given for these returns to life?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: What does this teach a person to think about?
questions.answer: Resurrection and gathering.

questions.question: In the tree example, what does the number four tell us?
questions.answer: Four parts of the tree are renewed.

questions.question: Which four parts are those?
questions.answer: The tree itself, leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does the passage say about one spring and the spring before it?
questions.answer: The later spring is shown just like the earlier one.

questions.question: Why is the living world called an army here?
questions.answer: Because many different groups are cared for in an organized way.

questions.question: About how many groups are in this army?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What does every group receive in a fitting way?
questions.answer: Its provision, protection, clothing, instructions, ending of duty, and tools.

questions.question: How carefully is this done?
questions.answer: Very carefully and in full order.

questions.question: What surprises us about when and how this is done?
questions.answer: It happens in unexpected ways and right on time.

questions.question: What does all this show about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: His power is without limit.

questions.question: What does all this show about Allah’s mercy?
questions.answer: His mercy reaches very widely.

questions.question: What is the earth like in spring in this passage?
questions.answer: It is like a page carrying a message of Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What happens in spring that is like many small examples of resurrection?
questions.answer: Many living things are brought forth again.

questions.question: How many examples are mentioned?
questions.answer: Three hundred thousand.

questions.question: Over what amount of time does this happen?
questions.answer: Over a few weeks.

questions.question: Is this done in a messy way or a disciplined way?
questions.answer: In a disciplined way.

questions.question: What living thing is used as a special example?
questions.answer: A tree.

questions.question: What four renewals are seen in the tree?
questions.answer: Its own renewal, and the renewal of its leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does each species in the great army receive that helps it live and function?
questions.answer: The right food, gear for defense, clothing, orders, release, and tools.

questions.question: How many different species are spoken of in that army?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: What words in the passage show nothing is forgotten?
questions.answer: It says there is no omission.

questions.question: What words show things do not get mixed up?
questions.answer: It says there is no confusion or mistake.

questions.question: What words show the timing is perfect?
questions.answer: It says everything is given at the proper time.

questions.question: What does this whole scene prove about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is One and unique, with endless power and mercy.

questions.question: How is Allah’s unity shown on the earth each spring?
questions.answer: It is shown like writing spread across the earth.
